467:t_1:3.en: ～$$地球連邦軍$$ $$極東支部$$　Private Room～

467:t_1:7.en:
$$甲児$$
(They definitely spoke to me... They said... they had Mom...)

467:t_1:8.en:
$$甲児$$
(I have... no choice but to go...)

467:t_1:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「I see... So you got that message too.」

467:t_1:17.en:
$n
「Yeah... Though I don't know what they're planning.」

467:t_1:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「Have you told everyone about this?」

467:t_1:20.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm asking you... Don't tell anyone.」

467:t_1:21.en:
$$甲児$$
「If we make the wrong move, there's no telling what they'll do to Mom.」

467:t_1:22.en:
$n
「It's definitely a trap. ...Though I don't know why they'd do something like this...」

467:t_1:23.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm going anyway... I'll save Mom with my own hands!」

467:t_1:26.en:
$n
「Don't worry about it. ...I still haven't fully come to terms with what happened to Mom, but it's in the past...」

467:t_1:27.en:
$n
「Go, $$甲児$$. I'll pretend I didn't see you.」

467:t_1:29.en:
$n
「But if $$マジンガー$$ leaves, someone will notice right away. Then $c will probably move out too.」

467:t_1:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「They told me to come alone. I'll settle this before everyone gets there.」

467:t_1:31.en:
$$甲児$$
「Even if it means fighting them.」

467:t_1:34.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$宗介$$ and $$アルト$$ aren't here. If I were gone too, there'd be no one left to look after you.」

467:t_1:35.en:
$n
「Yeah, exactly. I won't let you walk away with your win in our practice battle.」

467:t_1:38.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Are you sure...? About letting him go...?」

467:t_1:40.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Hey, $n... We can't interfere, but couldn't we help him out?」

467:t_1:41.en:
$n
「Of course. That's what I plan to do.」

467:t_1:42.en:
$n
「Besides, there's something I need to find out for myself.」

467:t_2:3.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「Who the hell are you...?!」

467:t_2:7.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「There's no need to hide it now. We watch over humanity's evolution... We are the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」

467:t_2:8.en:
$n
「That's strange... You don't look like formally trained soldiers at all...」

467:t_2:9.en:
$n
「I checked places near the abandoned $$科学要塞研究所$$ that might make good hideouts...」

467:t_2:10.en:
$n
「But even this place has terribly crude camouflage, from my perspective as a $$ビーストハンター$$.」

467:t_2:12.en:
$n
「Don't think you can win when you can't rely on your machines' performance!」

467:t_2:15.en:
$n
(They're putting up so little resistance... It's almost unnatural...)

467:t_2:18.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I am $$コード：ホワイト$$ now... A member of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists' operations unit.」

467:t_2:19.en:
$n
「Why...? Why are you with $$クロノ$$, $$マキ#pilot$$...?」

467:t_2:20.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I joined around April last year... They recruited me because they said I had potential.」

467:t_2:22.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「That's right. I joined $$クロノ$$ to change the world.」

467:t_2:23.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Though I never thought I'd end up fighting you...」

467:t_2:24.en:
$n
「Was what you told me on $$翠の地球$$ a lie?!」

467:t_2:25.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「A lie...? I didn't tell you any lies.」

467:t_2:26.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I'm both $$柏葉真紀$$, the nurse, and $$クロノ$$'s $$コード：ホワイト$$.」

467:t_2:27.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Unless the Captain gave me orders, I was simply a nurse working in Japan.」

467:t_2:28.en:
$n
「What do you mean by changing the world?! Does it have anything to do with the Reformists watching over humanity's evolution?!」

467:t_2:29.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「There's no need to know that. We simply follow Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s orders.」

467:t_2:30.en:
$n
「That's crazy! You joined $$クロノ$$ without even knowing what they do?!」

467:t_2:33.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「The Captain deserves our trust... Isn't that enough?」

467:t_2:35.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「This is a good opportunity, $n. I'll forgive you for turning your blade on the Captain.」

467:t_2:36.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「So come with me. I'm sure the Captain will welcome you if you apologize.」

467:t_2:38.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Let's go, $n. ...Or won't you listen to my request?」

467:t_2:40.en:
???
「...Oops. Looks like I interrupted a perfectly good love scene.」

467:t_2:42.en:
$$安$$
「Don't worry, $n. This scruffy detective is on our side... more or less.」

467:t_2:43.en:
$n
「$$安$$ of the $$くろがね五人衆$$!」

467:t_2:44.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Let me introduce myself to the new face.」

467:t_2:45.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「The detective job's in the past. I'm $$暗黒寺$$, and I work as Dr. $$剣造$$'s bodyguard now.」
